calls.title: SWORD Health + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The discussion centered on Sword Health's adoption of GrowthBook’s experimentation platform to enhance onboarding processes over the next six months, focusing on multiple experiment types including paywall revenue adjustments, copy changes, and image placements. With a strong emphasis on data privacy, the platform’s native architecture supports PHI-sensitive information securely, integrating seamlessly with BigQuery and Segment. Customization capabilities allow for granular targeting in mobile apps using SDKs in Swift and Kotlin. The meeting also highlighted the role of AI in simplifying experiment setup and analysis while reducing engineering dependencies post-SDK integration. Finally, the participants discussed pricing tiers and potential trials as Sword Health evaluates its options.
calls.keywords: experimentation, feature flags, data warehouse native, BigQuery, mobile SDK, onboarding optimization
